environment.description: EKS pod in us-east-1 VPC with S3 Gateway VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) configured with a scoped endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses aws:PrincipalOrgID condition and restricts s3:PutObject to keys matching a StringLike condition on s3:prefix requiring the caller's aws:PrincipalTag/team value as path component. Additionally, the VPC endpoint policy includes a Deny statement for any s3:PutObject where s3:x-amz-content-type is not 'application/json' AND where the object key does not match the pattern '${aws:PrincipalTag/service-name}/*'. The pod's IRSA role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ConfigServicePermBoundary) that restricts s3:PutObject to keys prefixed with 'app-config/ci-pipeline/' only. The pod runs with a Cilium network policy allowing ingress on port 50051 only from pods with label app.kubernetes.io/part-of=frontend in namespace 'production'.
